test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ratio of selling price to the cost price is 8 ∶ 11. What is the loss percentage?
solution:
Given:

The ratio of the selling price to the cost price is 8 ∶ 11 

Formula used:

Profit % = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100%

Where, SP = Selling price, CP = Cost price

Calculation:

Let the cost price (C.P.) and selling price (S.P.) of the article be 11x and 8x respectively.

According to the question,

loss % = [(11x - 8x)/11x] × 100%

loss % = (3x/11x) × 100 = 27.27%

∴ The Loss percent is 27.27%.
